title: Start a conversation
description: Body of POST /v1/conversations. With a client_id it is idempotent within the session (its chain, which a refresh keeps): the same client_id again starts nothing new and is answered, with 200, the conversation the first request made. Without one every request starts a new conversation (201).

opened_from.description: The source passed to Clomni.present(source) or startFlow; push when opened from a notification.

client_id.description: The app's own id for this start (UUID v4), made once and kept with the first message queued for it, so a retry or an offline queue sends the same one.
